messages:
arjun: hey — noticed a weirdness on the scorecard drilldown for last night's quant experiment (fp16 vs int8). counts on the per-sample table don't line up with the diffpanel exports :confused:
noah: ugh, saw that too. some sample rows are duplicated in the UI view, but export has unique sample_ids.
mia: can you paste the query / screenshot?
arjun: screenshot: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/scorecard/compare?run=2026-03-03 (can't share externally)
arjun: snippet of the front-end call: `GET /api/scorecard/compare?left=runA&right=runB&drilldown=sample` returns 120 rows but export csv is 115 rows.
noah: frontend logs show we dedupe on `display_id` before render. maybe display_id collides across quant runs?
arjun: that's the hunch — runner changed sample mapping in the quant job to use `created_ts` windowing; sample ids may have been re-assigned in the artifact.
eva: that would explain mismatch. this came up in QA too — flagged as a regression in rollout notes.
ci-bot: CI job #4821 for eval-runner reported: `WARN sample_map: overlapping windows, remapped 7 ids`
maya: pinging infra: did any storage cleanup / reingest run overnight?
arjun: infra said no. attaching a small log extract from the runner where remap happens:
```
2026-03-03T01:12:07Z INFO runner: starting quant-batch job id=qp-175
2026-03-03T01:12:31Z WARN sample_map: duplicate source_oid detected, remapping sample_id 9801 -> 11203
2026-03-03T01:12:31Z WARN sample_map: remapped 7 samples due to window collision
```
noah: ok, so UI's dedupe by display_id := `${dataset}:${sample_id}` will still show duplicates if sample_id got remapped but source_oid preserved. export pipeline uses canonical `source_oid` so counts differ.
mia: short-term fix: make UI export and drilldown use canonical source_oid for grouping. longer term: runner should emit stable sample_id that survives remap or annotate remap in metadata.
arjun: agree. I'll open a small frontend patch to switch grouping key to `source_oid` when available. PR draft: https://git.internal/redwood/frontend/pull/1298
noah: will review. also we should surface a yellow warning on the drilldown if `remap_count > 0` in run metadata so PMs aren't misled.
eva: yes please — product needs that signal. can you add a badge with tooltip: "7 samples remapped during runner processing"?
arjun: will add badge + link to run metadata.
ci-bot: created issue #MM-672: "scorecard drilldown mismatch when runner remaps sample_ids" assigned to arjun/noah.
maya: fyi ops, if this remap pattern repeats we'll get noise in alerts for sample-uniqueness checks. we should add a nightly check to compare export counts vs UI counts and alert > 1% diff.
mia: for postmortem, let's capture: (1) root cause = runner windowing collision remap, (2) impact = mismatch between drilldown and export, (3) mitigation = UI use source_oid + badge, (4) long term = stable sample ids or remap lineage in artifacts.
arjun: timeline: put quick UI patch today, badge + tests tomorrow, and follow-up runner ticket for lineage.
noah: I'll add a unit test for dedupe logic using mixed `sample_id`+`source_oid` cases.
eva: thanks team. once PR lands i'll update the run's rollout notes so QA knows. :thumbsup:
arjun: assigning to self, moving to WIP.
noah: reassigning review to @noah.
ci-bot: workflow: frontend-ci started for PR 1298
arjun: closing loop — if anyone sees other runs with weird deltas, drop them here.
